doc.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Playing at festivals
summary: Ross on being thrown into varied situations at festivals and playing solo piano early in the afternoon.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s it like at these festivals? Getting thrown in so many different situations and playing?

Well it’s good for you. You never know. Now today I’m just playing all solo piano so it’s a whole different story, which I wasn’t too ready for that at 1:30 in the afternoon. I’m not good. I do better after the sun goes down, personally. Some guys can do it, they get up at 10:00 in the morning, but it’s not my thing. Children of the night — I guess I belong to that group.
